custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at a location that has no untracked part.
  • Have a tracked part, part A, at that location whose part number, description and tags contain neither the word not nor the word tracked.
  • Start on that location's Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

Setup

  1. Make a new location: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Locations in the left menu, then New Location. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425642 LOCATION NEW in Name *. Click Save & Close. To switch to it: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick it.
  2. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425642 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425642-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 1. Click Save.
